note: SCHEMA AND FORMAT ONLY. This file contains NO provider response and NO evidence. The example_format block is SYNTHETIC, uses placeholders only, and must never be treated as, copied into, or cited as evidence. No response is automatically trusted: a record is only VERIFIED when it passes orca.eval.frontier_provider_resolution.validate_provider_response().
future_response_storage: docs/orneur/phase-21/evidence/provider_responses/ (created only when a real, owner-forwarded response exists; each raw file is stored verbatim and hashed)

required_fields.sender_identity: name/role/mailbox as shown by the provider
required_fields.sender_domain: must be an official provider domain (exact or subdomain) to be VERIFIED
required_fields.question_ids_answered: list of packet question ids actually answered, e.g. ['MIS-Q1','MIS-Q2']
required_fields.raw_response_location: path under the evidence root of the verbatim saved response
required_fields.sha256: 64-hex SHA-256 of the saved raw bytes (recomputed at validation)
required_fields.interpretation: reviewer's reading, reviewed against the exact question asked
required_fields.remaining_ambiguity: list; must be empty for any approved state change
required_fields.approved_state_changes: list of {field, from, to, evidence_kind} or {blocker_resolved}; only on a VERIFIED record
required_fields.expiry_or_freshness: date/condition after which the response is stale

evidence_tiers.A: published primary-source terms/documentation from an official provider domain
evidence_tiers.B: official provider written response from an official support/legal/business channel
evidence_tiers.C: provider account setting with captured evidence plus current documentation

verification_requirements: official provider domain (exact match or subdomain)
specific enough to answer the blocker; ambiguous replies are EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
raw response saved verbatim and SHA-256 recomputed from the saved bytes
reviewed against the exact question asked
no remaining ambiguity behind any approved state change

private_holdout_status.also_requires: verified account-setting evidence where the route is a provider setting

required_sequence: only then access status may change

example_format._warning: PLACEHOLDER FORMAT ONLY. Not a provider reply. Never cite.

provider_reference_binding.rule: A response's provider must equal the canonical provider of its reference_name; a valid domain for a different provider never substitutes.

attestation_limits: Machine validation proves internal consistency and source persistence (hash of saved bytes, official-domain string, binding). It does NOT cryptographically prove a human has not fabricated metadata or file content. Human/connector provenance remains part of evidence review.
